metadata.description: Holonomic recurrences for K3/elliptic candidate pairs (C3b moduli map extraction)

cooper_s7.source: OEIS A183204 (http://oeis.org/A183204); Cooper 2012 sporadic sequence s₇; Lean4 Structures/CooperS7Recurrence.lean
cooper_s7._meta_note: Recurrence is P0(n)·a(n) + P1(n)·a(n+1) + P2(n)·a(n+2) = 0. Leading coeff P2(n) = (n+2)³. MUM validated (monodromy at z=0 maximally unipotent). Shift order 2; generating-function ODE order 3 (K3-type).

cooper_s10.source: OEIS A005260 (http://oeis.org/A005260); Cooper 2012 sporadic sequence s₁₀; Lean4 Structures/CooperS10Recurrence.lean
cooper_s10._meta_note: Recurrence is P0(n)·a(n) + P1(n)·a(n+1) + P2(n)·a(n+2) = 0. Leading coeff P2(n) = (n+2)³ (same as s7, structural feature). MUM validated. Shift order 2; generating-function ODE order 3 (K3-type). Finalists: s7, s10, s18.

gorodetsky_s18.source: Gorodetsky arXiv:2102.11839 (https://arxiv.org/abs/2102.11839); recurrence transcription (14, 6, 192, -12) UNVERIFIED — see _meta_note.
gorodetsky_s18._meta_note: BLOCKED 2026-07-20: this entry's recurrence_python does NOT reproduce its own stated initial_terms (predicts a2 ≈ 0.544, not 672; non-integral). An exact fit of a general order-3 Apéry-like recurrence [(n+1)^3 leading] to the stated terms is underdetermined with non-integer coefficients — i.e. these terms do not satisfy any clean order-3 three-term recurrence, consistent with the peer-review G1-1 finding that s18 is order-4 in the tested window. The (14,6,192,-12) → recurrence_python translation is garbled and the sequence's true holonomic order is disputed. REFUSED for C3b until re-transcribed directly from Gorodetsky arXiv:2102.11839 (verify both the recurrence and the initial terms; do not compute values from memory).

apery_zeta2.source: OEIS A005258 (http://oeis.org/A005258); Apéry ζ(2) sequence; weight-2 elliptic; proven modularity (Beukers 1983, Beauville's classification of rational elliptic surfaces)
apery_zeta2._meta_note: Apéry's classical weight-2 sequence. Order-2 generating-function ODE (elliptic, not K3). Natural order-2 control for moduli-map pairing with weight-3 K3 sequences. MUM property holds (monodromy at z=0). Paired with cooper_s7 for C3b_cooper_s7__apery_zeta2 moduli relation extraction.

zagier_sporadic_A.source: OEIS A002893 (http://oeis.org/A002893); a(n)=Sum_{k=0..n} C(n,k)^2 C(2k,k); Zagier sporadic SECOND-ORDER sequence C, triple (A,B,λ)=(10,9,3), per Gorodetsky arXiv:2102.11839 Table (fetched 2026-07-24); Beukers-Stienstra 'Picard-Fuchs Equation and Formal Brauer Group of Certain Elliptic K3-Surfaces' (Math. Ann. 271, 1985).
zagier_sporadic_A._meta_note: History: CORRECTED 2026-07-20 (original recurrence was corrupt; predicted a2=-6 not 15; reconstructed by exact fit + OEIS fetch to A002893). F6 CORRECTION 2026-07-24: the 2026-07-20 verdict 'BLOCKED_WRONG_TYPE / genuinely order-3 generating-function ODE' was ITSELF wrong. Per Gorodetsky arXiv:2102.11839 (fetched) A002893 is Zagier's SECOND-ORDER sporadic sequence C (A,B,λ)=(10,9,3): it satisfies (n+1)^2 a(n+1)=(10n^2+10n+3)a(n)-9n^2 a(n-1), is MUM (C=(k+1)^2), integral, and its order-2 Frobenius/mirror construction is VALID (the earlier note conflated the sequence with its own symmetric square, an order-3 K3). STATUS NOW: valid order-2 sequence, but empirically RULED OUT as the partner of cooper_s7/s10 — check_C3b_moduli_map found no algebraic mirror-map relation up to bidegree 5 across 8 power-hypotheses, validated to q^32 (2026-07-24 partner sweep). The true partners are the symmetric-square roots cooper_s7_partner / cooper_s10_partner below.
zagier_sporadic_A._route_a_note: C3b-CAT relation with domb (A002895) FOUND, validated q^36 (C3b_domb__zagier_sporadic_A.json); Shioda-Inose status uncertified (A002893 is not domb's Sym2 sqrt). min-ODE order 2 (elliptic) refutes earlier 'K3-type' note.

cooper_s7_partner.source: DERIVED (not literature transcription): symmetric-square root of cooper_s7 (order-3, A183204), extracted by checkers/check_C3b_symsqrt.py; certificate data/certificates/C3b_symsqrt_cooper_s7.json. Integer sequence is OEIS A279619 (1,2,22,336,6006,117348,2428272,52303680,...; fetched b-file 2026-07-24).
cooper_s7_partner.closed_form: [order-2 partner operator L2 with cooper_s7 = Sym^2(L2); f = sqrt of the s7 generating function]
cooper_s7_partner._meta_note: Extended-form order-2 (B(n)=3(3n-1)(3n-2) is a full quadratic, not pure -Bn^2, so NOT one of Zagier's six pure sporadics). MUM validated; recurrence re-validated to n=58; mirror map z(q) equals cooper_s7's bulk z(q) exactly to q^14 (Sym^2 preserves the mirror map -> the C3b moduli map is the identity). This IS the weight-2 elliptic partner for the s7 K3. Verdict PASS(58): finite-order machine check; an all-n operator identity L3=Sym^2(L2) is a Stream-1 symbolic follow-up.

cooper_s10_partner.source: DERIVED (not literature transcription): symmetric-square root of cooper_s10 (order-3, A005260 = sum C(n,k)^4), extracted by checkers/check_C3b_symsqrt.py; certificate data/certificates/C3b_symsqrt_cooper_s10.json.
cooper_s10_partner.closed_form: [order-2 partner operator L2 with cooper_s10 = Sym^2(L2); f = sqrt of the s10 generating function; f is RATIONAL, not integral (denominators are powers of 2)]
cooper_s10_partner._meta_note: Extended-form order-2 (B(n)=(8n-5)(8n-3) is a full quadratic). MUM validated; recurrence re-validated to n=58; mirror map z(q) equals cooper_s10's bulk z(q) exactly to q^14. The partner series f is NOT integral (2-power denominators), so it is an operator-level partner rather than an Apery-like integer sequence — the elliptic partner exists as L2 even though it is not a catalogued integer sequence. Verdict PASS(58); all-n operator identity is a Stream-1 follow-up.
